title: Keep the rounding that fell away
hook: Keep the rounding that fell away. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.

doesNotKnow: Carry a compensation term so later additions can recover lost low-order contribution.

misconception: Changing addition order is the only way to reduce floating-point summation error.
objective: Carry a compensation term so later additions can recover lost low-order contribution.

claims.text: The compensation carries low-order contribution lost by a rounded addition into the next input. The witnessed comparison exposes a difference from naive accumulation, while the second case already represents its small increment exactly.
